about_the_game:
<DodgeShow 2> - Exclusive DLC! New Map! New Character!

------------------------------------

About the Map:

Welcome to the Wuji Sword Tomb — a mysterious training ground hidden in the Wuji region of Ionia. This is the sacred place where Wuji Sword Master and his disciples hone their skills, and a testament to the glory and sacrifice of countless warriors. At the edges of the map, you'll find various legendary swords buried, each one holding a unique story. Only the will of the strong and the endless challenges can allow one to survive on this blade-infused land. This is the ultimate trial ground where warriors sharpen both their mind and strength!

------------------------------------

About the Character:

With the signature abstract art style, 70% mischievous and 30% adorable, Little Wukong has arrived!
